purpose: Calibrate the construct and operating cost of the frozen Worker substrate by comparing legacy H0, a thin S6 state interface, and the implemented full S6 workflow. S6-Core is the prospective QRS substrate because it exposes stable state interfaces while leaving stage implementations evolvable. S6-Full is a disclosed human-authored workflow baseline that measures how much capability and headroom detailed process advice consumes. This is not a QRS, Evolver, Reviewer, promotion, sealed-evaluation, or method-superiority experiment.

treatment.control: Quant-H0 with the shared trusted reusable-harness runtime rule
treatment.core: Quant-H0-S6-Core with the same trusted runtime rule plus a thin six-stage state interface and trusted marker index; concrete methods and checks remain unspecified
treatment.full: Quant-H0-S6-Full with the same trusted runtime rule plus the implemented detailed stage workflow and trusted marker index
treatment.only_intended_differences: legacy versus an observable state interface, and the thin state interface versus detailed human-authored stage advice
shared: DeepSeek V4 Flash Worker model and provider route
one run_shell_command tool with a byte-identical descriptor
context, iteration, completion-token, temperature, streaming, timeout, and no-replay settings
rootless image, QFBench source and manifest, official verifier, task order, and concurrency
trusted reusable-harness and hidden-answer prohibition runtime rule

task_selection.family_role: low-variance rates contract and reconciliation task
task_selection.retained_selection_record: The historical five-run Quant-H0 screen was 17/19 in every run. This score is controller-side selection evidence only and is not reused as a fresh comparator or shown to either Worker.
task_selection.why_selected: It gives a stable two-property headroom reference and a compact public curve-construction workflow.

task_selection.retained_selection_record: The latest valid public-only Quant-H0 pre-screen was 47/51, while older runs were more variable. This is controller-side selection evidence only and is not reused as a fresh comparator or shown to either Worker.
task_selection.why_selected: Its long trace and repeated data, representation, operation, and reconciliation repairs test whether S6 changes real research behavior rather than only adding markers.

task_selection.family_role: short full-score ceiling and protocol-overhead control
task_selection.retained_selection_record: The latest valid public-only Quant-H0 pre-screen was 37/37. This is controller-side selection evidence only and is not reused as a fresh comparator or shown to either Worker.
task_selection.why_selected: It tests whether the state interface preserves a simple successful execution and whether Core or Full adds ritual, turns, tokens, or cost without useful behavioral change.

selection_boundary.task_choice_claim: Purposive mechanism calibration over one stable rates task and one complex holdings task; not a representative QFBench sample.

deploy_source_freeze.resolution: Deploy the future repository commit that first contains this plan, Quant-H0-S6-Core, S6-Full, the trusted runtime rule, parser, and then-current runner under the exact deploy_id. Record the revision in operational evidence without editing this plan.

execution.launch_policy: Run repetition 1 first with one Worker at a time. Audit protocol realization, execution validity, and accounting before launching the separately frozen reverse-order repetition 2. Never use repetition-1 scores to edit a Worker or substitute a task.
execution.resume: Resume only the same run ID and checkpoint. Never change task, model, provider, route, budget, or arm ordering after launch.
execution.invalid_recovery: No automatic third repetition. Retain an invalid cell as infrastructure evidence and stop for a separately frozen recovery decision.

headroom_vector: raw remaining failed-property count for each arm and cell
core and full minus legacy passed-property deltas for each cell
full minus core delta to isolate detailed human-authored workflow advice
fraction of paired legacy headroom closed by core and full when legacy is not full
FX full-score preservation and overhead ratios as a ceiling control
process_vector: marker protocol issues and explicit revisits
turns, tool calls, tool errors, artifact count, and execution validity
requests, input/output/total tokens, provider cost, and wall time
metrics.reporting: Report all six task-by-repetition blocks, all three arm values, and per-task medians. Report an equal-task macro only as a secondary summary so the 51-property holdings task cannot dominate. Do not use a mean-only summary, a significance claim, or one full-score cell as the decision. Marker coverage is not quantitative correctness.

terminal_interpretation.when: Any arm has an unrecovered invalid Worker/verifier observation or accounting cannot be reconciled.
terminal_interpretation.action: Do not tune S6 and do not infer capability or headroom from the invalid cell.

terminal_interpretation.when: More than one valid core or full cell lacks an accountable S1-S6 marker protocol or S6 enters before a terminal S5 marker.
terminal_interpretation.action: Repair only skill loading or marker protocol before any main baseline decision.

terminal_interpretation.when: Full materially and directionally improves over Core on both non-ceiling tasks without validity regression, or closes at least three quarters of the legacy headroom while Core does not.
terminal_interpretation.action: Report the gain as human-authored workflow engineering and retain Full as a disclosed strong baseline or ablation. Do not move its detailed stage algorithms into the QRS starting substrate merely because they score well. Keep Core as the construct-aligned QRS substrate and prescreen harder public development tasks if Core or Full removes existing headroom.

terminal_interpretation.when: Core realizes the marker protocol, preserves validity, has no repeated task-level regression, and has tolerable request, token, cost, and wall overhead. This decision does not require Core to preserve old task headroom.
terminal_interpretation.action: Retain S6-Core as the prospective QRS substrate because it exposes evolvable state interfaces without pre-solving stage behavior. If Core genuinely improves the baseline, disclose that human-scaffold gain and re-screen harder development tasks rather than weakening Core to manufacture QRS headroom.

terminal_interpretation.when: S6 shows a clear official regression in both repetitions of either task, materially higher invalidity, or pathological cost without compensating observability.
terminal_interpretation.action: Revise the workflow or retain legacy H0; do not attribute the regression to QRS.

answer_boundary: No Worker receives selection scores, failed-property identities, verifier output, expected values, diagnostics, candidate history, Reviewer feedback, or an Evolver instruction. All three receive only the public task/data, their frozen harness, and the same trusted reusable-harness runtime rule.
claim_boundary: This canary calibrates legacy, thin-state, and detailed-pipeline Worker substrates on three deliberately selected development tasks: stable headroom, complex variable headroom, and a full-score ceiling control. It is not QRS evolution, benchmark-wide baseline superiority, a population estimate, a stable promotion, a sealed result, or evidence that marker emission causes correctness.
